// @generated by co-arising 2.0 (Onion Layer: infrastructure.persistence — DO NOT MODIFY)
// Default zero-dependency in-memory persistence & idempotency pin store for local execution and testing.
// @ProvenanceId(layer:infrastructure:persistence)
// canonicalSha256: d07707b84cc37fa766fa7715c962b0b4fbfdd0b5410d0fd638df99748eb1dd9d

export interface PinnedRecord {
  readonly artifact: string;
  readonly inputs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface DispatchedRecord {
  readonly target: string;
  readonly payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export class InMemoryStore {
  readonly pins: Map<string, PinnedRecord> = new Map();
  readonly dispatches: DispatchedRecord[] = [];
  readonly snapshots: Map<string, Record<string, unknown>> = new Map();

  pin(artifact: string, inputs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): void {
    const key = `${artifact}:${JSON.stringify(inputs)}`;
    if (!this.pins.has(key)) this.pins.set(key, { artifact, inputs });
  }

  hasPin(artifact: string, inputs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): boolean {
    return this.pins.has(`${artifact}:${JSON.stringify(inputs)}`);
  }

  recordDispatch(target: string, payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): void {
    this.dispatches.push({ target, payload });
  }
}
